responsibility: Implements diagnostics and warning logic shared by C-family front ends after parsing but before later middle-end passes. It contains the semantic analyses and rich diagnostic emission for many C-family warnings—such as constant-expression overflow, logical-operator misuse, array comparisons, sizeof-related issues, misleading xor-as-power cases, and other language-specific warning heuristics—often coordinating with location/range labeling, spellcheck, and indentation helpers.
